pages.title: Flying Ointment
pages.text: Flying Ointment is a legacy crafting and ritual ingredient. Combine a Glass Bottle, Mandrake Root, Belladonna, Aconitum, a Poppy and wax in any arrangement. Tallow supplies forge:wax; compatible items in the same crop and wax tags also work. This is not a drinkable potion and does not grant flight.

pages.title: Altar Cup Upgrade
pages.text: Sneak-use Flying Ointment on the top of a formed altar section to place one as a cup upgrade. It adds 1 to the gain and multiplies capacity by 1.17. Only one cup-category upgrade counts: bottles, pots and goblets compete with it in altar traversal order. Multiple ointments do not stack their upgrades.

pages.title: Ritual Ingredient
pages.text: Flying Ointment is used by the restored $(l:sympathy/brooms)flying Broom rituals$(), $(l:sympathy/conjure_leonard)Conjure Leonard$() and $(l:sympathy/conjure_baphomet)Conjure Baphomet$(). The greater-demon rites can start by hand at night; a nearby sheep death is an alternative trigger. See each ritual for its circles, offerings and power costs.

pages.title: Recipe Verification
pages.text: Startup now checks item references and serializer IDs in bundled recipes, catching unknown items before opening a world. Full recipe parsing waits for world tags. This does not validate external datapacks, tag contents or live crafting transactions. In-world crafting, altar placement and Conjure Leonard still need playtesting.
